_comment: Audio fixture index for the gatekeeper smoke driver. Each WAV is canonical 16 kHz mono 16-bit PCM little-endian. Generated by `./generate-audio-fixtures.sh`; injected on-device by `./run-audio-fixtures.sh` via the GatekeeperDebugReceiver DEBUG_INJECT_AUDIO broadcast. Targets: `ambient` exercises the selected raw-audio backend (EdgeTPU Conformer if proven and enabled, otherwise Inherent or CPU recovery); `conformer` directly probes the recovered EdgeTPU Conformer path; `soda` exercises JniSodaCapability (libsoda_dev_jni). Text-only fixtures are kept as a fallback for regex/BERT regression checks but should not be the primary smoke path -- they exercise zero JNI.

audio_fixtures.phrase: Set a timer for ten minutes.
Remind me to call the dentist tomorrow.
What is the meaning of foreshadowing?
Schedule a meeting with Avery on Tuesday at three.
Send an email to the client about the renewal.
audio_fixtures._note: Top-1 audio output may be hasCreateDocIntent (5) since the email/doc surface shares a head; draft_email comes through the regex layer cleanly.
play_music has no dedicated BERT/audio head; verify via regex layer only.

audio_fixtures.phrase: Key insight from the meeting was customer churn dropped.
audio_fixtures._note: CPU SODA does not consistently emit final transcripts for this declarative memory fixture; use the raw-audio backend result for the isInteresting/add_to_memory quality signal.

audio_fixtures.phrase: Navigate to sixteen hundred Amphitheatre Parkway.

audio_fixtures._note: JNI/runtime smoke fixture: exercises the selected raw-audio backend without expecting a meaningful intent. Success criterion: the backend returns a finite result; SODA emits no transcript (or a low-confidence noise marker).

device_runbook: 1. Connect Pixel 9 or 10. Confirm `adb devices` shows it.
3. Grant mic permission (open the app once, accept rationale; or `adb shell pm grant com.google.research.air.cosmo android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO`).
5. The script validates the captured logcat and writes artifacts/audio-run/<timestamp>/logcat.txt.
ambient -> exactly one log line matching `audio inject ambient: ... result=GatekeepingResult(...)`; if Inherent scores are present, `assert-audio-fixture-run.py` writes a top-1 quality scorecard.
soda -> at least one `audio inject soda transcript:` line whose text is fuzzily similar to the source phrase.
Always: zero `UnsatisfiedLinkError`, zero `FATAL EXCEPTION`, JniSodaCapability never reports `soda_native_load_failed`.

negative_controls_for_regression.input: Ambient audio: it's a beautiful day outside

negative_controls_for_regression._why: Punctuation only; should be filtered or yield no matches.
anti regex 'shopping list|grocery' suppresses generic shopping-list mentions.
